name: cpig-74-strut-foam
description: 74 Stochastic Strut Foam (R6.5 Phase E Batch 1 — Stochastic)

setup.vlmDescription: NOT YET VERIFIED — render was blank on first bring-up. When fixed: a network of light-blue line segments connecting points in 3D space.
setup.whatItDoes: Implicit strut foam from a point cloud + connection rule. 0=KNearest, 1=RadiusBall. Each connection becomes a capsule strut. The Edges output (port 1) shows the strut network.
setup.whatYouShouldSee: NOTE: first bring-up render was BLANK. The Edges output must be wired to Custom Preview. When working: a network of capsule struts connecting the input points.

requires.fix: install the Slop yak package; on a dev machine a Release net48 build ships it to the Drive folder GH loads from - check `canary doctor` output for the location actually in use
install the CPig yak package, or on a dev machine build %CANARY_REPO_CPIG% CPig.Grasshopper (net48) and register its output folder in Grasshopper Developer Settings
this test loads a Slop definition from the CANARY_REPO_CPIG repo; check that repo out and point %CANARY_REPO_CPIG% at it (see workloads/tokens.json)
